refactor(facts): the today projection leaves the store, and the fact holds only days the sums lack (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.ktv)

The projection, its types and the day arithmetic are pure, and sat in the
module that owns pricing, transcript reads and observables; check and the
draw now value-import a small module of their own.

The session's days enter the fact only when its transcript lies outside the
set's projects, decided by the store's read (daysOutside), so the projection
loses its roots branch and a session under the roots no longer moves the
document on every ingest.

A one-day sums constructor replaces the two hand-built copies, and the
document test spells its expected today fact instead of calling the
production reading.

feat(facts): the draw's today and sources count are read from the document (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.ktv)

The today fact now carries everything the draw's day projection reads: the
directory's day sums and the rendering session's own days, with the session's
ingest failure as the fact failing. projectToday is a pure function of that
fact and the draw's instant, so todayOf takes no store, lane or ledger, and
the draw and the demo read the view's document. The render event's source
counts read the document's sources too. check projects a fixture fact through
the same todayOf, so CHECK_TODAY is gone.
docs(segments): a helper a shell command backgrounds ends with the run's process group (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.dal)

fix(sources): a shell run the timeout ends under a disposed registry publishes nothing (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.dal)

The launcher keeps the first cause that ended a child, so a run the timeout
signalled before dispose is reaped as a timeout with the source's abort set.
The reader gated the abort on the launcher's reason too, and published the
timeout's failure into the torn-down registry. It now throws the abort on
the signal alone, as the file reader does.

feat(sources): the shell reader has a read timeout, and a run past it is failed in its read phase (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.dal)

One parameter, 10 s, named beside the shell TTL floor and passed on the shell
reader's launch, so the launcher's one timeout path ends a command that never
writes and never exits. Its read fails naming the bound, in the read phase, and
the next period's run starts clean. Spec: docs/design/gather-and-renderer.md
section 19.

feat(facts): one SessionFacts per session, assembled from today's providers and restamped (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.af6) (#611)

* feat(facts): a session's facts document is assembled from today's providers and restamped against its last (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.af6)

* docs(facts): the facts document's traps in data-sources memory; payloadOf comments follow its split (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.af6)

* review(facts): equality has one judge, the view derives its inputs once (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.af6)

assembleFacts compares builtins and sources by the identity restamp already
returns, instead of walking every value a second time. The session source
derives its payload inputs once for both the payload and the readings.
Stale updateOf comment and a shadowed stop are fixed.

* review(facts): Wire refuses undefined, projectPayload keeps one header (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.af6)

JSON drops an undefined property and nulls an undefined array member, so a
type admitting it does not round-trip as itself.
